# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has a dark, sullen little face with black eyes. He is described as a cute little lad.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)_

## Personality

Anthony possesses an independent nature and a sullen, insolent demeanor. He holds a strong prejudice against female teachers, whom he believes are no good, and initially shows contempt and hostility toward Anne Shirley. He can be mischievous and enjoys defiant antics, though he displays respect once disciplined.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P28](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0028), [v2 c12 P30](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0030), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_

## History

Anthony Pye was taken in as an orphan nephew by Mrs. George Pye and subsequently enrolled as a student at Avonlea school under Anne Shirley. From his very first day, he held an antagonistic attitude toward Anne, remarking that she was no good because she was a female teacher. He engaged in disruptive behavior, such as pouring water down Aurelia Clay's neck and putting a live mouse in Anne's desk drawer. After the mouse incident, Anne lost her temper and whipped him with a hardwood pointer until he winced and cried. Surprisingly, this punishment gained Anthony's respect, causing him to offer to carry Anne's books the next morning and declare that her whipping was as effective as a man's. When Anne later resigned from teaching at Avonlea, Anthony fought two pitched battles with other boys to relieve his upset feelings.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P30](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0030), [v2 c12 P31](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0031), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052), [v2 c26 P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_
